integrity: Exact rational and complex finite checks are reproducible; proof is the mathematical evidence for the infinite claim; no independent audit or external certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to unit-modulus completely multiplicative weights; not to the Möbius vector or arbitrary GCD matrix indices. Priority beyond inspected sources remains qualified; the logarithmic-squared exponent is an upper bound, not claimed optimal for every weight.
title: Uniform logarithmic-squared GCD means for unimodular completely multiplicative weights
